name: BigEarthNet: Large-Scale Sentinel Earth Observation Archive
description: A massive benchmark archive for remote sensing image understanding constructed by the Remote Sensing Image Analysis (RSiM) group at Technische Universität Berlin. Consists of 590,326 image patches extracted from 125 Sentinel-2 tiles covering 10 European countries. Each patch is associated with multi-label land cover annotations derived from the CORINE Land Cover (CLC) inventory. An extended multimodal release incorporates co-registered Sentinel-1 synthetic aperture radar (SAR) data.
